motive: A slot dispute: Karthik's private note says he needed a reason to move Pulse and that a safety concern was enough if it was marked faculty-approved.
method: A real but already fixed cable concern led an unidentified caller to ask the control desk at 4:10 PM to hold Pulse. Sana recorded the caller as unidentified and could not reach Karthik. At 4:12 PM Karthik wrote that the faculty had cancelled Pulse and at 4:13 PM posted an announcement claiming faculty confirmation, although no connected faculty-office call to him exists in either phone log.
explanation: The control desk and faculty office logs agree that no call connected between the faculty office and Karthik before the announcement; the 4:11 call was an unanswered outgoing call from the control desk to him. The caller at 4:10 asked only for a hold and never claimed faculty authority. The procedure card required verification before changing the running order, and his private note shows a slot-related motive. The identity of the 4:10 caller is intentionally not part of the answer.

timeline.event: The cable is secured and tested; stage power checked at 4:10
An unidentified caller asks the control desk to hold Pulse pending a check (18 seconds)
Sana's outgoing call to Karthik does not connect
Karthik writes that the faculty cancelled Pulse and drafts the announcement
The announcement is posted and Pulse is removed from the running order
The faculty office's return call to the control desk is missed
Ananya arrives and disputes the cancellation

No connected faculty-office call to Karthik appears in either independent phone log.
Karthik announced a faculty cancellation anyway, and his private note shows why.
